Bun migration status: pass 1 shipped 2026-05-07, pass 2 is GitHub #112.

PASS 1 (BUN-ONLY DEV/PROD) — SHIPPED in this session:
- tsconfig: module:esnext, moduleResolution:bundler (drops two deprecation warnings cleanly; no .js-extension churn because bundler resolves extensionless imports).
- package.json: "type":"module"; sea script invokes bun; package-lock.json deleted, bun.lock is the source of truth.
- src shebangs: #!/usr/bin/env bun in src/index.ts, src/mcp-server.ts, scripts/sea-build.js, scripts/stress-test.mjs.
- __dirname → import.meta.dirname in src/utils/paths.ts and 2 test files.
- scripts/sea-build.js converted to ESM (import-syntax, node: prefixed builtins).
- All test spawns rewritten from `node dist/...` to `bun dist/...` (concurrency, entries-advanced, integration, integration-advanced, mcp-integration, init, cli-restructure tests + scripts/stress-test.mjs).
- CI release.yml: dropped both setup-node@v6 blocks, swapped npm ci → bun install --frozen-lockfile, swapped node scripts/sea-build.js → bun scripts/sea-build.js.

REMAINING NODE FOOTPRINT POST-PASS-1: only the test runner (vitest). Node not required for build, run, scripts, or CI.

PASS 2 (TEST RUNNER) — TRACKED AS #112, ELEVATED PRIORITY:
The ESM transition broke vitest+vi.mock auto-hoist semantics for the 2 mcp-server test files under BOTH Node and Bun (was previously Bun-only). Post-pass-1 baseline:
- Node + vitest: 1388 pass, 4 fail, ~156 lost to file-load failures.
- Bun + vitest: 1230 pass, 2 fail, 160 skipped.
The 2 entries-advanced responseSize failures are now consistent across runtimes (subprocess is bun in both cases — Bun's stdout capture differs from Node's).

DOMINANT COST UNCHANGED: 95 vi.mock across 31 files. vitest auto-hoists; bun:test mock.module() runs in source order. Each file needs per-file judgment to convert top-level imports of mocked modules to lazy await import() inside test setup. Not a codemod.

WHEN TO TAKE THIS UP: ASAP — the ~156-test coverage gap exists today. Don't ship v1.1.0 with this open.
